data.one_liner: Utility to paint dashed or dotted lines on a Flutter canvas.
data.what_it_does: DashPainter turns a Path into a dashed or dotted line. It also provides DashDecoration for easy use in decorations.
use_when: Need a simple dashed line in a CustomPainter
Want to add dotted or dashed borders to a widget via Decoration
avoid_when: Require complex animation or stateful behavior
Need a fully featured drawing library
data.setup_notes: Add dash_painter: ^1.0.2 to pubspec and import 'package:dash_painter/dash_painter.dart';
